decisionsTitle: «Trimite-i oferta» at any moment, with a supplementary place when none is free (amending §615, §420, §637)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02.** The race was full (150), its waiting list capped, and a club member he wanted at the start was waiting. He was told the by-hand path of §615 — open the list, set the automatic offers to «Nu», raise «Număr de locuri» in the editor, then «Trimite-i oferta» — and that the offer is refused after the registration close. He answered: «Vreau să pot „oferi loc” în orice moment, chiar și pe liste suplimentare». Asked what to change, he chose: «Trimite-i oferta» works at any time, and when no place is free it adds a supplementary place — the capacity grows by one, written in the journal, who and for whom — with no overbooking: the place is created explicitly by the Administrator's press. After the first launch he added: «vreau confirmare când depășesc limita» — the dialog says so beforehand and asks for an explicit confirmation whose button names the added place; a raise is never silent. His example: somebody who registered among the first but whose confirmation email was late in the outage, now on the waiting list.

### The detour it replaces

Under §615 a full race needed three screens for one chosen person: «Nu» in the editor (or the raise would offer the new place to the head of the line at once), «Număr de locuri» raised by hand, then «Trimite-i oferta» on the queue. After the close there was no way at all to send an offer by email: `offerPlaceToByStaff` threw `OFFER_AFTER_CLOSE`, because its deadline was capped by the close (§420) and would have been born lapsed. The desk's «Dă-i un loc» was the only verb left, and it needs the person standing at the table. §637's «Dă-i un loc acum» had the same detour on a full race («Nu», raise by one, press again).

### The decision

1. **After the close, the staff offer goes.** `offerPlaceToByStaff` no longer refuses after the close. Its deadline is the club's offer window («Termene», §377) from the moment of the press, capped by the **start alone** (`computeWaitlistOfferExpiry({ …, capByClose: false })`, used by this verb only). Its email carries `untilStart` beside `startsDeadline`, so the send's re-base (§513) moves it from the email's departure with the start as its one cap (`rebasedDeadline`'s `capByClose`), and the lapsed-offer guard of §520 (`offerAwaitingItsFirstEmail`) keeps it occupied while its email is queued until the start rather than the close. The maintenance job is woken for that deadline. The person accepts it by signing the declaration, as any offer. After the start the press is refused: an offer then would be born lapsed. `OFFER_AFTER_CLOSE`, `offerAfterCloseError`, `offerRefusalCode` and `Admin.errors.OFFER_AFTER_CLOSE` (both locales) are retired: this verb was their one thrower.
2. **The automatic offers keep §420's cap.** `fillAvailableSpots` and the maintenance sweep still cap an offer by the close and make none after it. An automatic offer is nobody's choice: made after the close it would go to whoever heads the line at a moment nobody watches, an email the club did not decide to send, and the list would be worked down one dead offer per run — the reason §420 gave. The staff offer is one press for one named person, by an Administrator who has just read the dialog.
3. **No free place → one supplementary place.** Under the same event lock, after the stale holds are expired (a lapsed declaration hold is released first, as far as the line wants its place, §160) and the places counted again: if a capped event has no free place (`computeOccupied(counts) >= capacity`), `addOneSupplementaryPlace` writes `capacity = capacity + 1` on **this one event row** (`repository.addSupplementaryPlace`; a series' other dates keep theirs; the row's `version` moves like any save's, so an editor opened before the press is told the event changed rather than writing the old number back; `updated_by_staff_user_id` is the Administrator), writes the audit row `event.capacity_raised_for_offer` — the actor, the event as the entity, `{ from, to, registrationId }`, no person — shown on that registration's page among «Ce a făcut echipa» as «Loc suplimentar adăugat pentru o ofertă («Trimite-i oferta»): 150 → 151», and, after the commit, expires the public count (`revalidatePublicContent("places")`), as the editor's capacity save does. Then it makes the ordinary offer to the chosen person, which occupies the new place **before** `fillAvailableSpots` runs in the same transaction: on «Da» the head of the line does not take it. Should the count still be full after the one place (a count above the capacity, which no path writes), §589's `NoFreePlaceError` refuses and the transaction writes nothing. An uncapped event never lacks a place and is never written. A second press for the same person is refused as before: the row is no longer `WAITLISTED`. Two Administrators pressing at once for two people on the last free place make one offer on the free place and one supplementary place — never two offers on one place (`tests/concurrency/capacity.test.ts`).
4. **«Dă-i un loc acum» (§637) uses the same helper.** On a full race the press no longer refuses with §589's sentence: one supplementary place, the same `capacity + 1` on that one row under the same lock in the same transaction, audited as `event.capacity_raised_for_place_now` (same metadata, its own label: «Loc suplimentar adăugat pentru un loc dat acum («Dă-i un loc acum»): {from} → {to}»), and the row takes it at once as `PENDING_DECLARATION`, before `fillAvailableSpots`. A family's live reservation is still the row's own place and adds nothing; a lapsed declaration hold may still go for the row first (§160).
5. **The question, before the press.** «Trimite-i oferta» is drawn on every `WAITLISTED` row of «Coada de înscrieri» and on the registration's page at any moment before the start, for the Administrator. The «i» that warned of a refusal on a full event is gone from it (it stays on «Dă-i un loc», §592). The dialog keeps §615's sentence with the deadline and adds, from the counts read for the page (`staffOfferIfMadeNow`, a lapsed declaration hold not counted as "full", as the server would release it): «Nu e niciun loc liber: apăsând, adaugi un loc suplimentar peste limită, capacitatea devine {n}.» when none is free, and «Înscrierile s-au închis: oferta e valabilă cel mult până la start.» after the close — each its own string under §511's 200 characters, both languages. When a place will be added the confirm button reads **«Adaugă un loc și trimite oferta»** instead of «Trimite-i oferta» (`staffOfferQuestion`). «Dă-i un loc acum»'s dialog says the same sentence on a full race (`confirm.givePlaceNowFull`, which no longer sends the Administrator through «Nu» and «Număr de locuri») and its button reads **«Adaugă un loc și dă-i locul»**. The server decides under the lock; the toast says what it did: «Ofertă trimisă; loc suplimentar adăugat: 151 de locuri.» (`registrationOfferedRaised`) or «Loc dat; loc suplimentar adăugat: 151 de locuri. Emailul cu declarația a plecat.» (`placeGivenRaised`), each counted through `countForm`.
6. **The words that said otherwise.** The «Ghid»'s «Alege tu cine primește un loc eliberat» no longer asks to raise «Număr de locuri» first, names the button that adds the place and says the offer works after the close; «Dă un loc cuiva care nu și-a confirmat adresa» drops the «Nu» + «Număr de locuri» detour; «Ce NU se poate face» says the one supplementary place is added in the open, after a confirmation, and written in the trail; «Când se pierde un loc» after the close names «Trimite-i oferta» beside «Dă-i un loc»; `SETUP.md` §39's margin recipe is «Trimite-i oferta» one by one, with «Nu» needed only to keep freed places for the club's choice; `AGENTS.md` §10.5 rules 3 and 6, §10.6 (the three places the capacity changes), §10.7 (the offer's start cap) and §15.11; CLAUDE.md's staff-verbs row.

### Unchanged, on purpose

- **«Dă-i un loc»** (the desk's paper confirmation, §67, §589, §592) still needs a free place and says §589's sentence on a full race. It confirms at once, on a declaration signed at the table; a place created by a volunteer's press at the desk is a different trust than an Administrator's choice in the backoffice, and nobody asked for it.
- **The automatic offers**, their order and §420's cap (above).
- **The editor's capacity field**, its series scope and its own raise (§147), which offers the new places to the line on «Da». Raising the places there is still how they open to everyone.
- **«Adaugă o înscriere»**: still the list's door while anybody waits (§615 criterion 6); it adds no place.
- **The Organizer** reads and changes nothing (§289): both verbs are `canManageRegistrations`, asserted in the action, the admin service and the service.

### No overbooking

The allocator never exceeds `capacity`. The capacity grows only by the Administrator's explicit, confirmed press, by exactly one, under the event lock, in the transaction that gives the place, and the trail names who and for whom. `kind` is in no condition: a test registration holding the place or chosen for it counts as a real one.

*Rejected:*
- **Letting the allocator overbook** (an offer with no place behind it, or a place counted as «extra» outside the capacity formula): two people told «the place is yours» for one place, or a second formula every count would have to learn (§10.6).
- **A bulk raise** («add N places and offer them to these N»): the owner asked for one person at a time; a raise of many places is the editor's, with its own offers.
- **A silent raise** — the press adding a place with the ordinary button and no sentence: the owner asked for a confirmation that names the added place.
- **Offering to somebody not on the waiting list**: a registration still waiting for its address has no verified address to send an offer to; «Dă-i un loc acum» (§637) is that person's door, and it now adds the same one place when the race is full.
- **The Organizer pressing it**: it changes the event's capacity and a registration, which §289 keeps from that role.
- **Capping the staff offer by the close and refusing after it** (§615 as it was): the very detour the owner asked to remove.
- **A separate «supplementary places» counter** on the event: the capacity is the one number every count reads; the trail already says which places were added, by whom and for whom.

**Consequences.** `registrations/service.ts` (`addOneSupplementaryPlace`, `PlacedByStaff`, `offerPlaceToByStaff`, `givePlaceNowByStaff`, `staffOfferDeadline`, `queueSpotOffer`'s `untilStart`); `registrations/repository.ts` (`addSupplementaryPlace`, `offerAwaitingItsFirstEmail`); `registrations/domain/hold-deadlines.ts` (`capByClose`); `registrations/domain/waitlist.ts` (`OFFER_AFTER_CLOSE` retired); `notifications/domain/deadline-rebase.ts` (`OFFER_UNTIL_START`, `offerLastsUntilStart`, `capByClose`), `notifications/deadline-rebase.ts`; `registrations/admin-service.ts`; `audit/repository.ts` (`event.capacity_raised_for_offer`, `event.capacity_raised_for_place_now`, `listAuditTrail`); `registrations/give-place-tip.ts` (`staffOfferIfMadeNow`, `staffOfferQuestion`, `givePlaceNowAhead`'s `raisedTo`); `ui/OfferPlaceButton.tsx`, `ui/QueuePanel.tsx`, the registration's page; `admin/registrations/actions.ts` (`offerPlaceAction`, `givePlaceNowAction`); `messages/{ro,en}.json`; `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `SETUP.md` §39. Tests: `integration/registrations/offer-any-time.test.ts` (new), `integration/registrations/give-place-now.test.ts`, `integration/registrations/waitlist-offers-setting.test.ts`, `concurrency/capacity.test.ts`, `unit/notifications/deadline-rebase.test.ts`, `unit/registrations/hold-deadlines.test.ts`, `unit/registrations/place-deadlines.test.ts`. No migration, no dependency.

**Open for the owner.** A supplementary place added on the source date of a weekly series is copied into the dates the series makes afterwards, as any capacity on the source is; the race is not a series, so this was left as it is.
changelogLine: - **«Trimite-i oferta» works at any moment, even on a full race** — after the registration close too (the offer then lasts at most until the start), and when no place is free the Administrator's press adds exactly one supplementary place (150 → 151) once the dialog has said so and its button «Adaugă un loc și trimite oferta» is pressed, written in the registration's trail with who and for whom; «Dă-i un loc acum» adds the same one place on a full race; the automatic offers and the desk's «Dă-i un loc» are unchanged. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Criterion 19 (amended): «Trimite-i oferta» is drawn on every waiting registration (its page and each waiting row of «Coada de înscrieri») at any moment before the start and is the Administrator's. Under the event lock it refuses a cancelled or finished event, a started one and a registration that is not `WAITLISTED` (a second press for the same person included); it no longer refuses a closed registration — the offer's deadline is the club's offer window from the press, capped by the start alone, its email's send re-bases it with the start as its one cap, and the person accepts it by signing — while the automatic offers keep the close as their cap and make none after it. When no counted place is free on a capped event (a lapsed declaration hold the line wants is released first), it raises that one event's capacity by exactly one (a series' other dates keep theirs) and writes `event.capacity_raised_for_offer` with the actor, from, to and the registration, shown on that registration's page; the chosen person's offer occupies the new place before the queue is filled, so on «Da» the first in line does not take it. An uncapped event is never raised. Its dialog says beforehand «Nu e niciun loc liber: apăsând, adaugi un loc suplimentar peste limită, capacitatea devine {n}.» with the confirm button «Adaugă un loc și trimite oferta», and after the close «Înscrierile s-au închis: oferta e valabilă cel mult până la start.», each under 200 characters in both languages (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 21 (amended): with no counted free place, «Dă-i un loc acum» is no longer refused: it raises that one event's capacity by exactly one under the same lock and in the same transaction, writes `event.capacity_raised_for_place_now` (actor, from, to, registration), and the row takes the new place at once — never the waiting list's; a family's live reservation still adds nothing. Its question says beforehand «Nu e niciun loc liber: apăsând, adaugi un loc suplimentar peste limită, capacitatea devine {n}.» and its confirm button reads «Adaugă un loc și dă-i locul» (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 17 (amended): on a full race the place «Dă-i un loc acum» gives is one supplementary place its press adds to the capacity, audited, never a place held within its deadline, offered or reserved for somebody else; the public count reads the raised capacity with that place taken (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The capacity changes only by the event editor's save or by an Administrator's confirmed press of «Trimite-i oferta» or «Dă-i un loc acum» for one chosen person on a full event, which adds exactly one place to that one event row under the event lock, after the stale holds are expired and the places counted again, in the transaction whose offer or place then occupies it — never the allocator on its own, and never past the count: two Administrators pressing at once for two people on the last free place make one offer on the free place and one supplementary place, never two offers on one place; `kind` appears in no condition (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Trimite-i oferta» at any moment, adding one confirmed supplementary place on a full race (and «Dă-i un loc acum» too)
